results.summary: Opt-in Projects v2 mirror in src/projects.js. `hkb init --project <number|new|url>` links or creates a project and appends the missing kb statuses to its single-select Status field (existing options kept; Todo/In Progress/Done reused as todo/running/done), storing the ids in board.json under "project". The dispatcher gets a last tick step that mirrors labels onto the project — one mutation per moved card, two on an issue's first touch — and repairs drift, so a drag in the Project UI is undone on the next tick. `hkb doctor` is silent unless a project is linked, then checks the `project` scope (fix: `gh auth refresh -s project`) and probes that the project and its Status field still exist. A deleted project or a lost scope is logged once an hour and skipped; the board is unaffected. The decisions are pure functions (planSync, matchOption, optionInputs, projectError, parseProjectSpec, parseTokenScopes) with 23 new tests. For the next worker: the happy path has never run against a real project — this host's token has no `project` scope — so the GraphQL mutation shapes are unexecuted.
